title: rosa spinosissima f. oligotricha
intro: Rosa spinosissima f. oligotricha, commonly known as Scotch Rose or Dwarf Scotch Rose, is a species of rose in the family Rosaceae. It is a low-growing, thorny shrub native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of Rosa spinosissima f. oligotricha include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and calm the skin. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat wounds, reduce inflammation, and promote tissue repair, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
